title: Provenance-Preserving MCP Tool Response Envelope
description: Enforces Berne Convention Article 6bis attribution, integrity digests, and canonical upstream URI preservation on Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool responses.

author_name.description: Canonical human creator name (Berne Art. 6bis paternity).

author_orcid.description: Persistent ORCID identifier of the human author.

source_uri.description: Canonical upstream repository URL or Zenodo DOI URI (never a middle-hop scraper).

canonical_doi.description: Persistent Digital Object Identifier anchoring the upstream work.

license_spdx.description: SPDX license identifier (e.g., MIT, Apache-2.0, CC-BY-4.0).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the canonical UTF-8 source text.

modified.description: Must be true if the text was summarized, truncated, or transformed by an LLM or indexer.

ed25519_fingerprint.description: Optional Ed25519 public key fingerprint attesting to the canonical release.
